The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. Sales associates market and train self-checkout to shoppers.

Maintain self-checkout units to include cleaning the units input and output belts, scanner glass, terminal display, magnetic card reader heads, and shutting down and rebooting as needed. Replace consumable supplies as needed. Charge mobile devices and device batteries as needed.

Sales associates understand how to perform functions from each of the following Self-Checkout application states: Shopping Mode, Store Mode, Assist Mode, Supervisor Mode, and Training Mode. Successfully interpret lane status indicators and clear all events identified by lane signals and lane status indicators.

May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel. Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment.

Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned. This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
Minimum of 1-year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Deine Mission
syte macht Immobilienentscheidungen smarter. Unsere KI analysiert Bebauungspotenziale, Sanierungsbedarfe und Wirtschaftlichkeit in Echtzeit und gibt über 200 Projektentwickler*innen, Makler*innen und Banken die Grundlage für bessere Entscheidungen.
Um syte in noch mehr Hände zu bringen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) in Münster oder Berlin . Du bist die erste Stimme, die Entscheider*innen der Branche erreicht – du öffnest die Türen, durch die syte geht. Das bedeutet konkret:
Sniper-Outbound: Du identifizierst und kontaktierst High-Level-Entscheider*innen (Geschäftsführer*innen, Leiter*innen der Projektentwicklung, Asset Manager*innen) bei unseren Top-Target-Accounts. Kein "Spray and Pray", sondern intelligente, recherchierte Ansprache.
Pipeline Generation: Du qualifizierst Inbound-Leads und generierst durch kreatives Outbound (Cold Call, E-Mail, Social Selling, LinkedIn) neue Opportunities für unsere Account Executives.
Qualifikation: Du führst erste Qualifizierungsgespräche, verstehst die "Pain Points" der Kund*innen (lange Due Diligence, fehlende Daten) und pitchst den Mehrwert von syte.
Dein Profil
Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise hast du 6-12 Monate Erfahrung im Sales, Business Development, oder Account Management – idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Drive sind ebenfalls willkommen.
Hunter-Mentalität: Du hast keine Angst vor dem Telefonhörer. Ein "Nein" ist für dich kein Rückschlag, sondern Ansporn. Du hast Biss und willst gewinnen.
Business-Verständnis: Mit deinem Gespür für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge denkst du dich schnell in komplexe Themen ein. Du verstehst, wie Geschäftsprozesse funktionieren, bringst erstes Interesse für Tech mit und kannst echtes Interesse für die Immobilienbranche entwickeln.
Interesse an Tech & Real Estate: Du musst kein Immobilienprofi sein, aber du solltest verstehen wollen, wie unsere KI die Branche verändert.
Lernbereitschaft: Du bist coachable, willst Feedback und hast das Ziel, dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte einfach erklären und auf Augenhöhe mit C-Level-Entscheider*innen kommunizieren.
Verfügbarkeit : Du bist bereit, mehrmals wöchentlich aus unserem Office in Münster (alternativ perspektivisch aus unserem Office in Berlin) zu arbeiten.
Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort
Einstiegstermin : Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
Einsatzort: Münster oder Berlin / hybrid
Anstellungsart: Festanstellung (Vollzeit, 40 Std./Woche)

Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!
Deine Beteiligung: VSOP-Programm: In Abhängigkeit von Rolle und Verantwortungsbereich ist eine virtuelle Unternehmensbeteiligung Teil deines individuellen Vergütungspakets.
Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.
Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.
Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.
Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:
Upskilling : Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
Equipment : Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
Steueroptimierte Benefits : Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.
BusinessBike : Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen.

About the Job We are hiring the “best of the best” sales professionals who are passionate about their craft and want to continue to excel within our elite sales organization. Our Sales Development Representatives will be the “tip of the spear” in the sales process within an assigned territory of business for prospective accounts.

The ideal SDR candidate should have the perfect mix of experience, sales intuition, career ambition, team oriented mindset, quota driven mentality, positive, confident and can handle rejection.

Top candidates will have excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills for high level conversations with C Suite stakeholders in medium to large organizations. Candidates need to be able to adapt to a fast paced environment, familiar with or able to learn our tools, and be able to ramp up quickly.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $50,610—$59,500 USD AI and our hiring process Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews.

About the role Azumo is hiring a Sales Executive to originate new AI and ML services engagements with enterprise and mid-market companies across the US and Canada.

Over 80% of our new revenue now comes from AI-driven projects, and we need a seller who can identify the right opportunities, navigate technical buying committees, and close deals with real engineering scope. This is a hunter role. You will own pipeline generation, qualification, and close.

You will work alongside our engineering leadership on technical discovery and proposal development. You will sell into CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of Data, and their teams.

What you'll do Originate new AI and ML services opportunities through targeted outbound, warm introductions, partner referrals, and inbound lead follow-up Build and manage a qualified pipeline across enterprise and mid-market accounts in the US and Canada Run technical discovery in partnership with our solutions and engineering leadership, converting business problems into defensible engagement scopes Shape proposals, SOWs, and commercial terms that reflect the real complexity of AI implementation work Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes involving technical evaluators, finance, legal, and executive sponsors Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in HubSpot Represent Azumo 's engineering credibility in client conversations, not just our company story Requirements What we're looking for Solid experience selling technology services or custom software engineering engagements to US-based buyers.

A track record of originating new logo business, not only expanding existing accounts Working fluency in AI and ML sufficient to hold a substantive first call with a technical buyer.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you do need to speak credibly about model selection, LLM applications, data engineering, and production deployment concerns Experience carrying quota against six-figure and low-seven-figure deal sizes with multi-stakeholder decision processes Strong discovery skills.

You lead with questions, not pitches Disciplined about CRM hygiene, forecasting, and pipeline reviews Written and verbal communication that holds up in front of senior technical and executive audiences Based in the United States and authorized to work in the US Nice to have Prior experience selling nearshore or distributed engineering services Existing relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, or Heads of Data at mid-market or enterprise companies Background in consulting, engineering, or another technical discipline before moving into sales Benefits Company benefits include: Paid Time Off Mentored Career Development U.S.

Holidays USD Remuneration Profit Sharing Maternity Coverage 100% Remote Compensation and location Remote within the United States. Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes base salary plus commission. About Azumo Azumo is a software engineering partner for the era of AI.

We have shipped production AI work for Meta, Discovery Channel, and dozens of other companies building real products on AI foundations. We are a services company, which means our credibility is measured by what we deliver, not by what we pitch.

This role exists because we are seeing more demand for AI implementation work than we currently have capacity to originate through our inbound only go-to-market strategy. Originally posted on Himalayas

Retail Inside Sales Team Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Reverse Mortgage Loan Officers within a national consumer-direct sales environment. This role serves as the primary leader for a team of approximately 8–12 Loan Officers, with team size varying based on business needs and organizational growth.

The Team Lead is accountable for driving sales performance, improving conversion metrics, ensuring compliance adherence, and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-focused service.

Through data-driven coaching, performance management, and operational partnership, the Team Lead works to maximize production while supporting employee development and organizational goals.

This position is ideal for an experienced reverse mortgage sales leader who thrives in a performance-based environment and possesses a passion for coaching, motivating, and developing top-performing sales professionals. Sales Leadership and Production
Drive team performance through consistent coaching, accountability, and sales leadership.
Lead sales discussions, brainstorming sessions, and best-practice sharing to improve individual and team performance.
Promote a results-oriented culture focused on achieving and exceeding sales objectives.
Monitor and improve lead conversion rates throughout the sales process.
Coach Loan Officers on effective borrower engagement, referral development, relationship-building, and consultative sales techniques.
Provide leadership support for unique borrower situations, escalations, and compliance-sensitive transactions when needed.
No personal loan production is expected
Coaching and Talent Development
Conduct ongoing call reviews and coaching sessions to identify strengths, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Deliver daily and weekly coaching designed to improve sales effectiveness, conversion rates, and customer experience.
Provide individualized development plans for Loan Officers at varying stages of performance.
Facilitate best-practice sharing across the team to promote continuous learning and collaboration.
Partner with the Training Department to support onboarding efforts and reinforce role-specific knowledge and application of training concepts for new hires.
Performance Management
Monitor individual and team performance metrics on an ongoing basis.
Utilize data and performance trends to diagnose performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
Conduct performance discussions, coaching conversations, and documentation as necessary.
Manage watchlists, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and disciplinary coaching processes in accordance with company policies.
Support recruiting, interviewing, and selection efforts to maintain appropriate staffing levels.
Compliance and Quality Assurance
Ensure adherence to all federal, state, investor, company, licensing, and regulatory requirements applicable to reverse mortgage lending.
Promote a culture of compliance and ethical sales practices.
Monitor quality assurance results and implement coaching strategies to address identified deficiencies.
Ensure Loan Officers properly follow established workflows, CRM requirements, call cadence expectations, lead management standards, and documentation procedures.
Maintain knowledge of industry regulations, compliance updates, and company policies.
Assist in the investigation and resolution of escalated borrower complaints, executive escalations, regulatory inquiries, and CFPB-related concerns.
May assume direct communication responsibilities with borrowers when appropriate to support complaint resolution or compliance obligations.
Pipeline and Operational Partnership
Partner closely with Processing, Operations, Underwriting, Closing, and other internal departments to facilitate efficient loan progression.
Assist with pipeline oversight and milestone management to identify and remove obstacles affecting production.
Resolve borrower, operational, and process-related escalations impacting customer experience or loan progress.
Serve as a liaison between Sales and Operations to improve communication, efficiency, and borrower outcomes.
Support company initiatives focused on workflow optimization and customer service excellence.
Reporting and Analytics
Prepare and publish daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting to team.
Analyze sales conversions, funnel metrics, contact rates, pull-through rates, and funding performance.
Utilize data to identify trends, diagnose performance opportunities, and implement action plans.
Leverage business intelligence tools and CRM reporting to support decision-making and performance management.

About the Business Development Representative
The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for proactively generating new outbound sales opportunities from scratch within an assigned territory.
This is a high-activity, outbound-focused role where success is driven by consistent execution across calling, emailing, and targeted outreach. BDRs serve as the front line of our go-to-market strategy , identifying potential customers, qualifying needs, and creating high-quality opportunities for Account Executives.
Why This Role?
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in technology sales. You'll gain hands-on experience in prospecting, discovery, qualification, and territory management while making a direct impact on business growth.
If you're energized by outbound sales, enjoy building relationships, and want to grow your career with a purpose-driven technology company, we'd love to hear from you.
📍US or Canada. This role is 100% remote.

🚀 A strong foundation for building a long-term career in SaaS and technology sales
📈 Clear opportunities for growth into other commercial roles.
💰 Competitive base salary plus variable incentive compensation tied to performance
🎯 Performance measured through a combination of activity, pipeline generation, and opportunity quality
🌟 Opportunity for additional incentives and expanded responsibilities as performance grows
🌎 The chance to make an impact by supporting organizations that manage one of the world's most critical resources: water
🏠 A fully remote and flexible work environment with a collaborative and supportive team culture
🤝 Exposure to cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success
🌐 Access to career development opportunities across Aquatic Informatics and Veralto's global family of companies
💡 Ongoing coaching, training, and professional development to help you succeed

Prospect into assigned accounts and territories through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and targeted campaigns to generate qualified pipeline.
Engage prospective customers, identify business needs and challenges, and conduct discovery conversations to assess solution fit.
Convert leads into qualified meetings, demos, and sales opportunities through consistent follow-up and relationship building.
Own and manage a defined territory, prioritizing accounts and maintaining accurate activity and pipeline data in Salesforce.
Track performance against key metrics and continuously refine your outreach strategy to improve results.
Partner closely with Account Executives to advance opportunities and ensure a smooth handoff process.
Collaborate with Marketing and Product teams to improve messaging, targeting, and overall go-to-market effectiveness.

1+ years of experience in a BDR, SDR, Inside Sales, or similar outbound sales role.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Environmental Science, or a related field preferred.
Experience in B2B and/or SaaS environment.
Proven success generating pipeline and achieving activity or opportunity targets.
Strong prospecting, discovery, and customer engagement skills.
Experience using CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.
Excellent communication, organization, and follow-through skills.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Canonical is growing its channel sales team to capitalize on rapidly growing demand from channel partners, leveraging their expertise and connections to bring open source technology to organizations across a multitude of industries.
The role requires a mix of both farming and hunting capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned annual growth quotas.
They should be able to identify, prospect, and engage reseller and distributor partners to build and maintain relationships and grow Canonical’s business within the assigned territory.
The successful candidate must be comfortable owning and leading initiatives in an unstructured, startup-like environment. This individual must be able to sell open source, cloud, virtualization, and technical software solutions.
Although the role is focused primarily on reseller and distributor channel partners, the successful candidate must be capable of and comfortable with initial customer discovery calls and presentations as appropriate.

Develop and execute channel strategy for distributors and resellers within the assigned territory
Increase awareness of Canonical as a lead player in Open Source and Cloud (Private, Hybrid, Multi, and Public models)
Identify and recruit new potential partners in assigned territory
Leverage personal network and prospecting skills to engage new partners and build on Canonical’s already-successful relationships
Guide partners through onboarding and enablement
Develop mutually beneficial go-to-market plans and commitments with partners
Arrange and execute sales and pre sales trainings to these resellers
Drive and manage channel pipeline through recurring partner interactions
Support partner’s satisfaction and act as trusted advisor and point of contact
Maintain a regularity/frequency of contact with priority resellers and distributors.

Detail oriented with strong follow-up skills
Effective negotiating skills with ability to close sales
Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills (written and verbal)
Productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation
Mature approach to long-term relationship development with customers
The ability to represent the company at external events
Start-up experience would be an advantage

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.
Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:
Customer First : We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality : True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design : We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal : Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.
Social & Environmental Responsibility : We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.
Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.
If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

As a Business Development Representative on Quince's B2B team, you will drive new business growth through outbound prospecting across assigned U.S. territories. You will identify and source qualified opportunities for Account Executives, qualify inbound leads, and build relationships that fuel our enterprise sales pipeline. Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will combine strategic outreach, relationship building, and technology-enabled prospecting to generate consistent opportunities.

Identify and target new business opportunities across assigned territories by researching companies, building prospect lists, and sourcing the right contacts for Account Executive engagement
Conduct personalized outreach via email and social media to connect with prospects, schedule discovery meetings, and communicate Quince's value proposition
Accurately document all prospect interactions, qualification status, and outreach activity in our CRM system to ensure seamless handoffs to the sales team
Establish and maintain prospect relationships by understanding their business needs and communicating how Quince solutions address them
Attend quarterly trade shows to represent and sell the Quince brand in person, generating live leads and strengthening market relationships
Leverage AI and technology tools to scale prospecting efforts; bring ideas and test new approaches to improve outreach efficiency and conversion rates
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics to effectively position Quince against alternatives

1+ years of experience in sales development, lead generation, or a similar B2B role

Die Stelle – auf den Punkt gebracht
Diese Stelle ist eine klassische Hunter\-Rolle. Ihre erste Aufgabe besteht nicht darin, ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio zu verwalten, sondern eines aufzubauen. Sie identifizieren Industrieunternehmen in Ihrer Region, die noch nicht mit CRIDEC zusammenarbeiten, öffnen Türen, bauen eine Pipeline neuer Kunden auf – und halten sie systematisch am Leben.
Wir handeln lieber vorausschauend, als Entwicklungen einfach hinzunehmen: Das ist einer unserer Werte – und genau das erwarten wir von unserer Verkaufsentwicklung. Nicht warten, bis der Markt zu uns kommt – ihn aktiv erschliessen.
Erobern – der der Stelle
Industrieunternehmen in der Region Mittelland, die noch keine Kunden sind, identifizieren und aktiv akquirieren.
Qualifizierte Termine vereinbaren, den Bedarf im Bereich Sonderabfallentsorgung erfassen und passende Lösungen entwickeln.
Abschliessen: Preise kalkulieren, Angebote erstellen – auch die komplexesten – und den Auftrag gewinnen.
Nachverfolgen – mit unnachgiebiger Disziplin

Das CRM in Echtzeit pflegen: Jeder Besuch, jede Nachfassaktion, jede Gelegenheit wird erfasst.
Ihre Tätigkeit anhand von Kennzahlen steuern: qualifizierte Termine, Abschlussquote, Pipeline. Sie kennen sie, verfolgen sie und stehen dafür ein.
Repräsentieren
Das Gesicht von CRIDEC im Mittelland sein: Branchenanlässe, Partner, Verbände.
Eng mit dem Verkaufsteam zusammenarbeiten und sich auf unsere beiden Standorte Eclépens und Winterthur abstützen.
Was uns antreibt
Bei CRIDEC steht Schutz an erster Stelle: Das ist der eigentliche Sinn unserer Arbeit. Wir handeln lieber vorausschauend, als Entwicklungen hinzunehmen, halten unsere Versprechen auch dann ein, wenn es schwierig wird, und gehen den Weg gemeinsam, mit gegenseitiger Wertschätzung.

In dieser Position bekommen diese Werte eine ganz konkrete Bedeutung: Jedes einem Interessenten gegebene Versprechen wird eingehalten, jede angekündigte Nachfassaktion wird durchgeführt, und jeder gewonnene Kunde wird gut betreut.

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
Ready to make an impact?
Join us and help organisations build the capabilities they need to detect threats faster, respond smarter, and emerge stronger from cyber incidents. Your next challenge starts here.

Tu transformes l-attention, les contacts et les potentiels du marché en véritables opportunités de vente. Sur le marché suisse des PME, tu ouvres les bonnes portes, identifies les potentiels et mets notre initiative RH-pour-PME en avant de manière ciblée. Tu ne penses pas en termes de produits individuels, mais en fonction des défis de nos clients - et tu poses les bases de relations durables.
**Ce que tu accomplis**
* En collaboration avec le marketing et les ventes, tu identifies des entreprises cibles attractives, des segments de marché ainsi que les interlocuteurs et centres d-achat pertinents.
* Tu prends en charge de manière ciblée les leads et signaux issus de campagnes, événements, webinaires, téléchargements, demandes sur le site web, LinkedIn, recommandations et notre réseau, et tu les développes.
* Tu contactes personnellement et bien préparé les clients potentiels via LinkedIn, e-mail et téléphone, en privilégiant la pertinence et la qualité plutôt que le simple volume d-activité.
* Lors des premiers entretiens, tu découvres la situation du client : problème, besoin, taille de l-entreprise, systèmes existants, potentiel, timing et processus décisionnels.
* Tu fixes des rendez-vous qualifiés de manière contraignante et transmets les opportunités de façon structurée à l-expert solutions approprié.
* Tu documentes de manière compréhensible les contacts, les informations et les prochaines étapes dans le CRM, afin que les signaux précieux ne soient pas perdus.
* Avec le marketing et les ventes, tu analyses quels groupes cibles, messages et canaux fonctionnent, et tu fais évoluer continuellement notre approche.
### **Notre offre** ###
* Tu joues un rôle clé dans la mise en place de notre acquisition systématique de nouveaux clients sur le marché suisse des PME.
* Avec notre portefeuille de logiciels RH autour de Personio, SwissSalary, Arbeitszeugnis swiss+ et Edi, tu abordes les clients de manière orientée solutions plutôt que centrée sur les produits.
* Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec le marketing, les experts solutions, les consultants et les partenaires, et tu intègres directement les retours du marché dans notre développement.
* Tu peux influencer activement les canaux, messages et processus et ainsi contribuer à la manière dont nous sommes perçus sur le marché.
* Chez nous, la qualité, l-impact et les relations clients durables comptent plus que la simple pression sur les KPI.
* Ce rôle t-offre de la place pour grandir professionnellement, prendre des responsabilités et façonner activement l-avenir des RH en Suisse.
**Comment nous rendre heureux**
* Tu as de l-expérience en tant que SDR, BDR, Inside Sales Manager ou dans un rôle similaire et maîtrises le métier de SDR.
* Tu prends plaisir à acquérir de nouveaux clients de qualité et à établir de nouvelles relations.
* Tu communiques avec assurance par téléphone, e-mail et LinkedIn et expliques des sujets complexes de manière simple.
* Le suisse allemand fait partie de ton quotidien, et tu possèdes d-excellentes compétences écrites en allemand.
* Les RH, la digitalisation, les logiciels et les défis des PME suisses t-intéressent vraiment.
* Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée, autonome et fiable, tout en restant curieux et persévérant.
* La réflexion, le travail d-équipe et l-impact plutôt que la simple pression sur les KPI correspondent à ta personnalité et à notre culture.
* Une expérience avec les systèmes CRM et la prospection commerciale digitale est un avantage.
**Ce qui t-attend**
* Travailler à Dübendorf avec une infrastructure de premier ordre, en télétravail et sur site chez nos clients.
* Travailler en réseaux plutôt qu-en hiérarchies.
* Beaucoup de collègues passionnés et sympathiques qui se réjouissent de te rencontrer et de faire la fête avec toi lors des prochains événements.
* Travailler dans une équipe passionnée, engagée et dynamique.
* Travailler au cœur de l-actualité et contribuer à façonner l-avenir des RH en Suisse.
* Participer à l-élaboration de l-offre stratégique.
**Tu es intéressé ?**
Envoie-nous ta candidature en ligne avec ou sans lettre de motivation.
Jasmin Arpagaus (+41 44 215 15 78) de l-équipe RH se fera un plaisir de répondre à toutes tes questions.
Sur notre page carrière, tu trouveras d-autres aperçus passionnants de notre manière de travailler, de notre culture et de nos avantages - et tu découvriras pourquoi il vaut la peine de faire partie de HR Campus.
Nous ne prenons pas en compte les candidatures des agences de recrutement.

**Et si votre histoire professionnelle se poursuivait à la BCV ? **
Rejoignez la première banque universelle du canton de Vaud, l-une des banques les plus solides au monde, et ses quelque 2000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs. Prenez part au succès d-une institution notée AA par Standard & Poor-s depuis 2011 et contribuez à l-essor du tissu économique vaudois ainsi qu-à l-attractivité et à la vitalité de notre région.

**Vos missions principales :**
* conseiller et servir notre clientèle interne et externe (par téléphone, email et chat), en répondant à leurs demandes commerciales, administratives et de support,
* détecter et saisir les opportunités commerciales (gestion courante, prévoyance, hypothèque, placements) et, le cas échéant fixer des rendez-vous auprès des conseillers en agence,

* contribuer à la qualité de service en assurant le bon traitement des demandes et réclamations, ainsi que la mise à jour fiable de nos outils CRM.
**Votre profil :**
* titulaire d'un CFC de commerce ou équivalent,
* expérience confirmée d'au moins 2 ans au sein d'un service clientèle,
* très bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques,
* dynamique, excellent sens du service et esprit d'équipe,
* parfaite maîtrise du français, très bonnes compétences en anglais ou en allemand (oral et écrit), une autre langue constitue un atout.

Aufgaben
* Mit deiner freundlichen und fachkompetenten Beratung begeisterst du unsere Kundschaft.
* Du hältst dich an die internen Vorgaben und so stellst du sicher, dass die Waren attraktiv präsentiert sind.
* Mit der Ware auf unserer Verkaufsfläche und im Lager gehst du gewissenhaft um.
* Wenn nötig, hilfst du gerne auch in anderen Rayons mit.
* Bestandes-, Verkaufs- sowie inventurrelevante Prozesse sind Teile des Prozessmanagements, das du übernimmst.
Anforderungen
* Verkaufen und Beraten sind deine Leidenschaft, die Kundenzufriedenheit deine Motivation? Perfekt.
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch, du hast Verkaufserfahrung und idealerweise eine abgeschlossene Verkaufsausbildung: Dann bist du hier richtig.
* Selbstverständlich bist du bei den Einsatzzeiten (Mo. bis Sa.) flexibel. Gehört für dich im Verkauf dazu.
* Im Bereich Kasse/Services kennst du dich aus? Damit kannst du bei dieser Stelle besonders punkten.
* Immer ein freundliches Lächeln - das ist dein Geheimnis zum Erfolg.
Was wir bieten
* **Vergünstigungen:** Rabatt auf das Reiseangebot ITS Coop Travel, 5-fache Anzahl Superpunkte im Supermarkt, bis zu 20% Rabatt auf verschiedene Versicherungsleistungen, bis zu 20% Rabatt in allen Formaten der Coop-Gruppe, günstigere Mobile- und Prepaid-Abos bei Coop Mobile, Reka-Card: Vergünstigung bei Bezug, Personalrabatt auch für Partner:in (im gleichen Haushalt lebend), Vergünstigung bei GA-Abonnement
* **Anstellungsbedingungen:** Pensionskasse: 2/3 wird von Coop einbezahlt, Gesamtarbeitsvertrag (GAV), 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub und 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub, Treueprämien, Sparplan bei der Pensionskasse, Flexible und attraktive Regelung für eine vorzeitige Alterspension ab dem vollendeten 58. Altersjahr, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen
* **Arbeitszeit:** 5 Wochen Ferien
* **Weiterbildung:** Über 600 interne Weiterbildungskurse, Unterstützung für externe Aus- und Weiterbildungen, Talentmanagement mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

TL;DR – Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Fachkräfte für das Gesundheitswesen von morgen. Unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna automatisiert bereits heute die Patientenkommunikation in Arztpraxen. Wieso praxipal?
Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten.
Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Du findest smarte Wege, verloren geglaubte Leads wieder zu reaktivieren, und holst so Potenzial zurück, das andere längst abgeschrieben hätten
Du steuerst deine Pipeline, pflegst unser CRM und machst deine Lead-to-Demo-Conversion über Daten messbar und optimierbar
Du baust praxipals Go-to-Market-Motion von Grund auf mit auf: Du entwickelst Playbooks und Gesprächsleitfäden, die zum Standard für unser wachsendes Sales-Team werden
Du spielst eine Schlüsselrolle dabei, ein leistungsstarkes Sales-Team aufzubauen und zu skalieren, und prägst damit, wie bei praxipal in Zukunft verkauft wird

SailPoint is the leader in Identity Security. SailPoint customers represent half of the Fortune 500 and half of the ASX 50. This customer strength provides us with a great community of customers, partners and analysts who trust SailPoint and our team to solve complex challenges. SailPoint continues to grow globally and expanding our global presence creates opportunities for top salespeople to become a part of our awesome culture.
The rapid adoption of AI and agent-based systems is driving an explosion of non-human identities — including agents, bots, service accounts, and APIs — operating at a scale and speed traditional identity models were not built to govern.
As organisations look to operationalise AI, identity is emerging as the control plane that determines what these entities can access, what actions they can take, and how they interact across systems.
The Advanced Technology Specialist (ATS) plays a critical role in helping customers define this new model — enabling faster AI adoption while ensuring appropriate governance across both human and non-human identities.
We are proud of our team and the culture we have built which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Executive – Agentic Technology Specialist in Germany, to focus on selling our Agentic related technology solutions (specifically, Machine Identity Security, Data Access Security, Agent Identity Security, and Shadow AI Remediation) into our largest and most complex strategic accounts.
This role is critical in driving the adoption of these innovative solutions, and the candidates should have experience selling across IT stakeholders, ideally combining Identity or cybersecurity experience in addition to agentic technologies and/or data architecture or governance technologies.
